caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a female figure standing on a rectangular wooden platform equipped with four small wheels at the corners. The figure has brown skin and long, dark hair, and wears a crown or headdress composed of large, upright feathers colored in shades of brown, gold, and red. She is dressed in a red garment with gold trim and green and gold accents, with a green sash tied around her waist and feathers decorating the skirt. The figure’s right arm is raised, with the hand holding a bundle of cigars or similar brown cylindrical objects. Her left hand holds a closed book with a brown cover. The figure's right foot is placed on a small red and gold step, while the left foot is on the platform. She wears gold shoes with green straps. The background of the drawing is plain off-white, with no other objects or scenery included.
title: Cigar Store Indian
